svg.title: Pulseboard: from bounded signals to one evidence-backed next check (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: synthetic probes check seven public origins while the heartbeat line pulses. A consented Alibi event is accepted by the collector allowlist, a Taskdeck event is refused because that integration is inert, and a Voices message has an email removed on the server. Aggregates update in Cloudflare D1, and the Desk proposes one next check with its numerator, denominator, window, limitation and human action.
svg.text: a small operations desk for everything you ship
synthetic probes · allowlisted, consented collection · Cloudflare Worker + D1 · output = one next check

g.text: Two Alibi starts did not finish
a person decides what happens next

svg.text: Scheduled synthetic probes check seven public origins
An Alibi event with player consent is on the allowlist: accepted
Taskdeck is not allowlisted, so its integration stays inert and the event is dropped
Voices feedback: links, email and phone-like text are removed on the server
The Desk proposes one next check, not a score
Source, window, numerator, denominator, limits and a human action, kept together
